title: Goals record
description: A record is an entity plus the dated, sourced claims made about it. Summary fields (name, category, confidence, ...) are a convenience view; the claims are the source of truth. Entity types map to common CRM tables (crosswalk-crm.csv) and to Open Referral HSDS (crosswalk-hsds.csv).

id.description: Stable identifier, '<entity>:<scheme>:<value>', e.g. org:ein:010552773. Never reused after retirement.

entity_type.description: offering covers programs, services and resources.

crm_table.description: Table in a common CRM schema that holds this entity (accounts, contacts, events, products, documents, ...).

category.description: A category id from the domain profile, or 'unclassified'.

flags.description: Quality flags raised by the pipeline (specs.md, Quality flags).

origin.description: How a value entered the dataset. ai_proposed and rule_proposed values never serve as gold labels.

claim_id.description: Optional stable id, assigned when claims are stored individually (D1 table claims).

property.description: What is being claimed: name, address, category, county_fips, status, phone, url, hours, eligibility, ...

source_id.description: Key into pipeline/sources.json, or a URL for a single page.

reviewed_by.description: Role or process id, never a veteran's identity.

contradicts.description: claim_ids this claim conflicts with. Conflicts are kept, never overwritten.

supersedes.description: claim_id of the earlier claim this one updates.
